summary: Checkout page and Polish price format
description: Shoppers accept the terms on the checkout page before they can place an order. Prices are shown in Polish format.
acceptanceCriteria: The Place order button is disabled until the terms are accepted, then enabled.
Prices on the products page use the pl-PL format with the currency, e.g. 24,99 zł.

comments.author: designer
comments.body: The button uses data-testid place-order; the checkbox is accept-terms.
